item.title: Stereoelectronic effects in glycan conformation
item.description:
Authors: Junki Fujihara, Francesco Palmieri, Martina Delbianco

This Tutorial Review discusses the stereoelectronic effects that determine glycan conformation. Chemical strategies to tune these effects and control glycan conformations are discussed to inspire new glycan designs.

item.title: Dye-based fluorescent organic nanoparticles: from chemistry to biology
item.description:
Authors: Chloé Grazon, Eleonore Kurek, Ophélie Dal Pra, Morgane Rosendale, Mireille Blanchard-Desce

Dye-based fluorescent organic nanoparticles ( d FONs) are highly versatile and tunable nanoplatforms for bioimaging. This review highlights recent advances, current challenges and future opportunities to move d FONs beyond proof-of-concept applications.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cs00272b

item.title: Alkali-promoted Fe-based multimetallic catalysts for CO 2 hydrogenation to C 2+ chemicals: from reaction mechanism to catalyst development
item.description:
Authors: Miao Zhang, Limin Zhang, Hui Gao, Yulong Liu, Na Liu, Yi Liu, Guanghui Zhang, Chunshan Song, Xinwen Guo

Key aspects of Fe-based catalysts for CO 2 hydrogenation to C 2+ chemicals, covering the reaction mechanism, catalyst design and preparation, promoter roles, and active phases.

item.title: Bioorthogonal catalytic materials for precise chemical control in living systems
item.description:
Authors: Cheng Feng, Huajia Wang, Jinhe Guo, Wei Feng, Jian Lu, Yu Chen

Bioorthogonal catalytic materials integrate diverse reactions, material designs, and responsive regulation for precise chemical control in living systems. Their versatility enables applications in protein engineering, diagnosis and therapy.

item.title: Green solvent-mediated extraction of biomolecules: opportunities, advances, and future directions
item.description:
Authors: Luan B. Corso, Aaftaab Sethi, Manohara Halanur, Radek Zbořil, Olga Ferreira, Simão P. Pinho, Gregory Franklin, Mónia A. R. Martins, Dibyendu Mondal

item.title: The potential of nanosized zeolites in catalysis
item.description:
Authors: Chunzheng Wang, Mathias Barreau, Francesco Dalena, Hailing Guo, Svetlana Mintova

This review highlights nanosized zeolites in catalysis, emphasizing enhanced diffusion through shortened pathways and increased external surface area, which improve reactant accessibility, catalytic activity, selectivity, and stability.

item.title: Gold complexes as systems-disruptive anticancer agents: beyond thioredoxin reductase inhibition
item.description:
Authors: Ester Giorgi, Francesca Binacchi, Claudia Ghelarducci, Chiara Gabbiani, Damiano Cirri, Alessandro Pratesi

Gold complexes perturb interconnected redox, mitochondrial, proteostatic and signalling networks, a proposed route to multiple regulated cell-death modes.

item.title: Luminescent materials based on aromatic bisimides—part 1: the smaller pyromellitic and naphthalene derivatives
item.description:
Authors: Swadhin Garain, Menyhárt B. Sárosi, Subi J. George, Frank Würthner

This review describes the advancements in the development and application of small aromatic bisimides, with a particular focus on their fluorescence, thermally activated delayed fluorescence, phosphorescence, and circularly polarised luminescence.

item.title: Transition metal-based nanocatalysts for bidirectional immunomodulation: from catalytic anti-inflammation to catalytic immunotherapy
item.description:
Authors: Bowen Yang, Jianlin Shi

This tutorial review elucidates the chemical basis of nanocatalytic bidirectional immunomodulation, highlighting how transition metal-based nanocatalysts suppress hyperactive immunity and activate suppressed immunity for disease treatments.

item.description:

This review summarizes recent advances in porous materials for SO 2 capture, compares their adsorption mechanisms and structure–performance relationships, and highlights challenges and prospects for flue gas desulfurization.

item.description:
Authors: Alexa Hanlon, Charles Schreiber, Trevor Sando, Edward Mather, Bree Mitchell, Aashutosh Mistry

Aqueous battery electrolyte design heuristics for improved transport are identified herein, and considerably differ from the lithium electrolyte designs.

item.description:
Authors: Siqin Huang, Yanfei Shi, Yuan Li

Differing from the aromaticity recovery-stabilized radicals explored since 1907 and AIE, we elaborate the mechanism, experimental and theoretical validation, material design, potential application and future directions of the AIR concept with ACQ.

item.description:
Authors: Bartosz Godlewski, Olena Vakuliuk, Wojciech D. Petrykowski, Beata Koszarna, Krzysztof Górski, Mariusz Tasior, Yevgen M. Poronik, Krzysztof J. Kochanowski, Łukasz W. Ciszewski, Anna M. Grabarz, Denis Jacquemin, Daniel T. Gryko

item.description:

This Tutorial Review discusses uses of modern synthetic tools in the total synthesis of natural products over the last five years, including photocatalysis, electrochemistry, biocatalysis, skeletal editing, flow chemistry and mechanochemistry.

item.title: Antifreeze proteins in action: structural determinants, hydration dynamics, and ice-binding mechanisms
item.description:
